name: BCL Industries Ltd
title: BCL Industries Ltd-$ - 524332 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 ethanol volumes rose ~74% to 53,000 KL as diversion to ENA/SBF offset lower OMC allocation; realisations under pressure, but 150 KLPD Bathinda unit adds ~INR300 crore revenue at full run-rate, with ~75% utilisation targeted from Q2.

utilisation.quote: we'll be able to atleast utilize the 75% of the capacity starting from the second quarter

capex.quote: we hope to commence production at the rated capacity. With this, our total installed capacity would stand at 900 KLPD.

triggers.label: Capacity 750 → 900 KLPD by Q1FY27
triggers.quote: With this, our total installed capacity would stand at 900 KLPD.

triggers.label: Realisation under pressure from competition
triggers.quote: realization remained under pressure due to the highly competitive pricing environment in the market

triggers.label: Capacity to 1,150 KLPD via Fatehabad
triggers.quote: that will take the overall capacity of the company from 900 KL to 1,150 KL

triggers.label: PML volume 4.5 lakh cases, up 20%
triggers.quote: We have sold almost 4.5 lakh cases in Q4 FY26, which is up by 20% year-on-year.

guidance.value: at least 75% from Q2 FY27; rated capacity by first week of July
guidance.quote: we'll be able to atleast utilize the 75% of the capacity starting from the second quarter
we are expecting somewhere around INR300 crores from that 150 KLPD unit
I think we will be able to maintain or rather improve the EBITDA margin of 11.8%

guidance.metric: Fatehabad 250 KLPD ethanol plant and 20 TPD CBG
guidance.value: commission within ~2 years; CBG about 1 year later
guidance.quote: within 2 years, we will be able to commission our 200 KLPD plant you can say ethanol

guidance.value: debt-free within 5 years; net debt about INR335 crore at Mar-26
guidance.quote: within 5 years, we should be a total debt -free company

red_flags.label: Realisations squeezed by competitive ENA pricing
red_flags.quote: realization remained under pressure due to the highly competitive pricing environment in the market

red_flags.label: Biodiesel plant idle pending OMC price revision
red_flags.quote: at present, we are not able to manufacture because there has not been any price revision

evasions.quote: So can't comment upon anything as to what is in their mind and how they will react.
they are taking their own time. So can't comment.
